params.name: query
params.doc: plain text, case-insensitive; a regex with opts.regex

params.name: opts
params.type: { books?: 'rules' (PHB, DMG, 2024 SRD; default) | 'monsters' | 'all' | '2014' | pack id | pack id[] (an unknown word answers the rules set with a warning), limit? (5, max 20), snippet? (240, max 600), regex? }

methods.returns: { query, books, total, shown, hits: [{ book, journal, page, uuid, matches, snippet, edition? }], note?, truncated?, warning? } | { error }
methods.doc: Full-text search of the owned books, one hit per page, most matches first. Returns an object — iterate `.hits`; `total` counts every matching page. A 2014 hit carries edition: '2014'.

params.name: ref
params.doc: a hit's uuid from search(), or an exact-then-substring page name

params.name: opts
params.type: { books?: 'rules' (PHB, DMG, 2024 SRD; default) | 'monsters' | 'all' | '2014' | pack id | pack id[] (an unknown word answers the rules set with a warning), maxChars? (6000), offset?, raw?, tables? (true) }

methods.returns: { book, journal, page, uuid, text, edition?, truncated?, totalChars?, nextOffset?, warning?, tables?: [{ name, formula, uuid, rows } | { uuid, error }] } | { journal, page, uuid, raw } | { notFound, name, closest, hint } | { error }
methods.doc: One page as plain text, with its embedded roll tables. Page past maxChars with offset = nextOffset. A UUID that is not a page (a JournalEntry) answers empty text with a warning, and its uuid echoed as given.

params.name: name
params.doc: exact, then substring, across the Monster Manual, 2024 SRD, PHB and DMG actors

params.name: opts
params.doc: text: true adds each feature's enriched rules text

methods.returns: { name, pack, uuid, cr, ac, hp, size, type, features: [{ name, type }], warning? } (text: features: [{ name, type, activation, recharge, text }], languages, speed) | { notFound, name, searched, hint } | { error }
methods.doc: A shallow stat-block digest with the actor uuid; warning names any dnd5e data path that moved.

params.name: q
params.type: { size?, type?, cr? ('1/4', 3, '1/2-2'), minCr?, maxCr?, name?, limit? (40, max 200), packs? (pack id | pack id[]; anything else answers the default packs with a warning) }

methods.returns: { count, shown, monsters: [{ name, cr, size, type, uuid, pack }], hint?, warning? }
methods.doc: NPCs by size, type and CR from the Monster Manual then the 2024 SRD, one per name, lowest CR first. Returns an object — iterate `.monsters`.

methods.returns: { classes, subclasses: { <class>: [] }, species, backgrounds, feats: { origin, general, fightingStyle, epicBoon, … } } | one of those keys
methods.doc: The PHB's own names for a character spec (species as the book spells them: 'Elf, High').

methods.returns: { world, foundry, system, packs: [{ id, present, label?, type?, entries?, edition? }] }
methods.doc: Which book packs are installed — the session-opening probe.

methods.returns: { spell, uuid, level, edition?, list, onList: true | false } | { spell, uuid, level, edition?, list, onList: null, hint } | { notFound, spell, hint }
methods.doc: Is a spell on a class's (or subclass's) list, from dnd5e's spell-list registry. A 2014 spell carries edition: '2014'.

methods.returns: { list, count, spells: [{ name, level, uuid, edition? }] } | { error, known }
methods.doc: The spells on a list, one per name (the PHB's copy first), by level then name. A 2014 row carries edition: '2014'.
Foundry HTML to plain text: enrichers reduced to their labels, tags and entities stripped.

methods.returns: { ok, passed, failed, checks: [{ label, ok, detail }] }
methods.doc: Live checks of every assumption against the installed books; run after a sync or an update.
